title: Mutational signature of extracranial meningioma metastases and their respective primary tumors

publications.title: Mutational signature of extracranial meningioma metastases and their respective primary tumors.

institution: LMU University Hospital Munich (Center for Neuropathology and Prion Research / Department of Neurosurgery)
platform: Illumina TruSight Oncology 500 (TSO500) targeted NGS panel

brain_invasion.counts: 1/9 samples CNS-infiltration positive ('yes': case 1 primary convexity tumor), 7/9 negative ('no'), 1/9 not applicable ('n/a': case 2's pulmonary extracranial metastasis sample)
brain_invasion.determination_method: Not reported (deposited file has a per-sample 'CNS infiltration' yes/no/n/a column; the paper's methods describe only general neuropathological workup -- H&E, Ki67 IHC, H3K27me3 IHC -- without stating the specific criterion used to call CNS infiltration)

anatomic_location_breakdown: Primary tumor sites: convexity (case 1), convexity (case 2), fronto-basal (case 3), intraventricular (case 4). Case 3 also has a local intracranial recurrence at the same fronto-basal site (18.9 months post-primary) before its extracranial spread -- not itself a second extracranial metastasis. Extracranial metastatic sites per case: lumbar vertebral body L4 (case 1, 210.1 months post-primary), pulmonary (case 2, 6.1 months), cervical spinal canal/neuroforaminal C3-C4 (case 3, 20.5 months), lumbar spinal canal intradural adjacent to nerves L5 (case 4, 12 months). 4 cases x 2-3 samples each: cases 1/2/4 have 2 samples each (primary + one extracranial metastasis), case 3 has 3 samples (primary + one local recurrence + one extracranial metastasis) = 9 total.
sex_distribution: Not reported (no sex/gender column in the deposited table)
age_distribution: 9 specimens across 4 cases, ages at resection ranging from 49.72 to 71.55 years
processed_data_format: Per-case variant-call annotation table (xlsx): TSO500 gene-level variant/CNV calls (NF2, TERT, PIK3CA, PTEN, BAP1, CDKN2A/B, and others) plus DKFZ/Heidelberg 850k (EPIC) methylation-classifier class/score annotation per sample
needs_manual_review_reason: Directly downloaded and inspected the deposited file (40478_2023_1505_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx, 'Additional file 3'): a genuine per-case table of 9 rows across 4 unique cases, each with paired primary-tumor and extracranial-metastasis samples, TSO500 targeted-panel variant calls (NF2, TERT, PIK3CA, PTEN, BAP1, CDKN2A/B, EP300, ERBB3, GNAS, KDM5A, KLHL6, NOTCH1, PIK3C3, POLE, RAD50, SLIT2, SUFU, TGFBR2), and DNA-methylation-classifier ('850K Class/Family/Subclass', v12.5) annotation columns. IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE: the '850K Class' columns are classifier OUTPUT (a class name and confidence score), not raw Illumina EPIC/850k array data (no beta values or IDAT files are present in this file) -- this record is therefore classified modality=targeted_panel_seq only, NOT dna_methylation_array, since the underlying methylation array data itself does not appear to be deposited here (it may exist in a DKFZ/Heidelberg classifier-internal reference set not part of this supplementary file). UPDATE 2026-07-11 (centralized integration pass): a 'metastatic' treatment_timepoint_status value was added to docs/controlled_vocabulary.md specifically for this dataset's core design (matched primary tumor + extracranial metastasis per case), and treatment_timepoint_status above now reflects both timepoints directly. grade_breakdown/sample_count/patient_count/age_distribution were computed directly from the 9 data rows (case IDs 1-4) in the downloaded file, not taken from the abstract. Institution inferred from PubMed author affiliations; the figshare funding field separately lists 'Universitätsklinik München'. tags.large_cohort is set false regardless of this cohort's actual size, per instruction that large_cohort requires centralized recomputation across the whole inventory after this extraction batch, not a per-record judgment. RE-VERIFICATION AUDIT 2026-07-12: (1) corresponding_author corrected from 'Mario M. Dorostkar / Christian Schichor' (a prior last-authorship inference) to 'Annamaria Biczok'; the actual correspondence data both in PubMed efetch (email Annamaria.biczok@med.uni-muenchen.de) and in the PMC full text (only the first author's contrib carries corresp="yes") identifies A. Biczok as the sole corresponding author, per the instruction to use email/footnote data rather than author-list position. (2) grade_breakdown re-verified directly from the deposited file's 'Integrated Dx' column across the 9 rows (G1: 4 [Microcystic G1, Microcystic G1, Meningothelial G1, Papillary G1]; G2: 3 [two Atypical G2, one Papillary G2]; G3: 2 [two Anaplastic G3]); the existing 4/3/2 value is correct and unchanged. sample_count=9, patient_count=4, age range 49.72-71.55 also re-confirmed from the file. DEEP-AUDIT FIX 2026-07-14: re-downloaded and fully parsed the deposited xlsx (40478_2023_1505_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx, all 9 data rows x all columns) directly from the figshare API/ndownloader link and cross-checked against the live PMC full text of the linked paper (PMC9840245, PMID 36641486). Two things were wrong. (1) brain_invasion.status_reported was false/'Not reported', but the deposited file has an explicit per-sample 'CNS infiltration' column with values yes/no/n/a (row-by-row: case1-primary=yes, case1-met=no, case2-primary=no, case2-met=n/a, case3-primary=no, case3-recurrence=no, case3-met=no, case4-primary=no, case4-met=no) -- 1/9 positive, 7/9 negative, 1/9 not applicable -- corrected status_reported to true and counts populated; determination_method left 'Not reported' since the paper's methods only describe general neuropathological workup (H&E, Ki67, H3K27me3 IHC) without stating the specific criterion for calling CNS infiltration, so tags.brain_invasion_annotated correctly stays false (that tag requires a stated determination method, which this source lacks). (2) treatment_timepoint_status was ['primary','metastatic'], omitting a real third category: case 3 in the deposited table has 3 rows, not 2 -- row order is primary tumor (fronto-basal, t=0), a SECOND fronto-basal sample at t=18.9 months (same site, same grade/diagnosis as the primary), then the true extracranial metastasis (cervical spinal canal, t=20.5 months). The live PMC full text confirms this second fronto-basal sample is a local intracranial recurrence, not a metastasis: case #3 had a local recurrence at the primary site before later developing the cervical-spinal extracranial metastasis. This was miscategorized as an undifferentiated 'metastatic' sample previously. Corrected treatment_timepoint_status to ['primary','recurrent','metastatic'] and tags.recurrence_annotated from false to true (the dataset explicitly distinguishes primary (4, one per case) vs. recurrent (1, case 3's second fronto-basal sample) vs. metastatic (4) samples, with counts, satisfying the tag definition). anatomic_location_breakdown text also corrected to describe case 3's true 3-sample composition instead of implying all non-primary samples are metastases. has_outcome_data re-confirmed false/correct: live full text states 'Due to the small sample size and short follow-up period no statement could be made about long-term tumor control' -- no survival/RFS data reported. grade_breakdown, sample_count, patient_count, age_distribution, molecular_subtype_annotated all re-confirmed unchanged and correct.
